analysis.narrativeEn:

· Position vs SMA100/200($0.18/$0.22): potential entry into a weaker mid-to-long term trend zone

· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.0021 → -0.0003) + improving within negative territory, trend reversal signal still weak

· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation) + consider buying on confirmation of $0.19 support, expect bullish turn on breaking $0.26 resistance
